title: ScoringOutput
description: Severity assessment for a triaged ticket. Output of the scoring LLM, consumes the extraction LLM's structured output.

ticket_id.description: Pass-through identifier from the extraction step.

severity.description: Ordered severity level (critical > high > medium > low). Examples — critical: total breakdown with safety risk ('Heizung aus, -2°C, Familie mit Kleinkind'). high: active damage in progress ('Heizung tropft, Wasser auf dem Boden'). medium: functional but degraded ('seltsame Geräusche, funktioniert aber'). low: routine inquiry ('Wann ist meine nächste Wartung?'). When uncertain between two adjacent levels, pick the higher one.

severity_reasoning.description: One short sentence in German explaining the primary reason for the severity assignment. For human and DPO explainability.

confidence.description: Relative confidence signal for ranking purposes. 1.0 = the model would stake its reputation on this answer; 0.0 = the model has no idea. NOT a calibrated probability — use only for relative comparison and threshold-based human-review routing.
